environment.description: CLI tool deployed as individual Lambda functions invoked per-user via API Gateway with Cognito authorizer. Each user's Lambda execution role has an IAM policy with dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition. The permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/TenantIsolationBoundary) attached to the execution role includes a Deny statement with StringNotEquals on dynamodb:LeadingKeys against the ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id} variable. The Cognito user pool propagates the authenticated user's sub as a session tag (tenant_id) via STS tag-based session policies during AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity. Additionally, the table has a resource-based policy fragment via AWS::DynamoDB::Table policy that cross-references the caller's principal tag. Note: the condition key dynamodb:LeadingKeys only applies to Query and Scan operations; GetItem and DeleteItem rely on the separate dynamodb:Attributes and dynamodb:EnclosingOperation condition context, which is handled by a secondary inline policy statement using a ForAllValues:StringEquals condition on dynamodb:LeadingKeys for item-level operations via the undocumented but functional behavior of LeadingKeys evaluation on single-item APIs when the partition key matches.

config.cognito_mapping: Cognito sub -> STS session tag tenant_id -> PrincipalTag/tenant_id
config.runtime: Per-user Lambda with scoped execution role, no shared credentials
